description:
`Distill.main(System.argv())` after a defmodule -> parse error at item position (frontdoor.rs:153-156; parse_item :124-149 accepts only items and Ident-headed macro calls). Every path submits root main/0 (cli.rs:668,700).

Decision (2026-10-17): a file's top-level expressions become the program's main/0, in order, after all definitions are published (a superset of Elixir, which also rejects use-before-defmodule). A file with both top-level expressions and its own main/0 is a compile error naming both. Files with only def main() are unchanged. Reader: parse_program (frontdoor.rs:96) collects expression items and synthesizes one def main() item through the same builder path as parse_item_macro_call, so interp/JIT/AOT and fz2 build need no change.
title: Script mode: a file's top-level expressions run in order
